description: Werkelijk rendement 2029: an unrealised equity gain is not taxed, but the vastrentend interest is and the DUO interest still counts
source: Hand calculation from the bill text: Wet werkelijk rendement box 3, Kamerstukken 36 748 nr. 2 (https://zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl/kst-36748-2.html: art. 2.13, 5.1, 5.2, 5.40, 5.65, 5.67, VI) as amended by novelle 37 053 nr. 2 (https://www.tweedekamer.nl/downloads/document?id=2026D55225: art. 5.26, 5.32). No official calculator exists (#16).
derivation: 2029 is the first werkelijk year, so the verkrijgingsprijs steps up to the 1 January value: 120.000. The equity fund gains 8.000 but nothing is sold, so there is no vervreemdingsvoordeel. Resultaat (art. 5.2) = vastrentend interest 4.000 (taxed yearly, 4% × 100.000) − DUO interest 675 (2,70% × 25.000, negative income) = 3.325. Heffingsvrij resultaat 1.800 (art. 5.40; not indexed in the start year, art. VI) → inkomen 1.525; no earlier verliezen → belastbaar 1.525; tax 36% (art. 2.13) × 1.525 = 549,00 → 549. Without the DUO debt it would be 36% × (4.000 − 1.800) = 792. If everything were sold at year end (art. 5.32), the 8.000 gain is realised: resultaat 11.325 → inkomen 9.525 → tax 3.429; realisation tax 3.429 − 549 = 2.880 (= 36% × 8.000).
